subject: gk
question:
Fill in the blank:
The Gaganyaan mission is a three-day mission that aims to send ______ astronauts into space.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Three**__

**__Key Points__**
__

• The **Gaganyaan mission** is India's first human spaceflight program, designed to demonstrate the country's capability to send humans into **Low Earth Orbit (LEO)**.

• The mission aims to launch a crew of **three astronauts** to an altitude of **400 km** for a duration of **three days**.

• The mission concludes with the safe return of the crew, landing them in **Indian sea waters**.

• The spacecraft consists of an **Orbital Module**, which includes a **Crew Module (CM)** where the astronauts will reside and a **Service Module (SM)** providing necessary support systems.

**Additional Information__**

• The **Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO)** is the lead agency for the Gaganyaan project.

• The launch vehicle identified for the mission is the **LVM3** (Launch Vehicle Mark-3), which was previously known as **GSLV Mk III**.

• The four astronaut-elects selected for the mission are **Group Captain Prashanth Nair**, **Group Captain Ajit Krishnan**, **Group Captain Angad Pratap**, and **Wing Commander Shubhanshu Shukla**.

• Before the manned flight, ISRO will conduct uncrewed missions, including one featuring a humanoid robot named **Vyommitra** to monitor module parameters.

• With the success of this mission, India will become the **fourth nation** in the world to launch a crewed spaceflight mission, after the **USA**, **Russia**, and **China**.
